title: Laddu, Chintu and Dadaji's Weather Moustache
moral: When we listen to others, we are ready for anything.
description: Dadaji's big white moustache wiggles whenever the weather is about to change, but Laddu and Chintu just giggle and run off to their picnic! Meet sun, snow, wind and rain with Laddu, Chintu, Pinky, Dadaji and Golu the goat in this funny animated story for kids aged 3 to 8 about listening to others.
intro: Hi friends! Welcome to Little Lantern Stories! Today's story is... Laddu, Chintu and Dadaji's Weather Moustache! Is your umbrella ready?
outro: The End! Remember, friends: when we listen to others, we are ready for anything. And Laddu says... is it jalebi weather yet? See you tomorrow... bye-bye!

Snnnnore! Dadaji fell fast asleep, right in the middle of his sentence!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: I'm awake! I was just... resting my eyes!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: A weather moustache? Hee hee! Look, it's sunny! The sun is hot, hot, HOT!
So hot that Laddu bought an ice gola. Cold, white, crunchy ice! It looked just like the cold, white weather in the mountains.

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: I know what it's called! It's called... flying milk!
Hee hee! No, Laddu! Friends, what is the cold, white weather that falls in the mountains?
SNOW! Snow is cold and white! And then... CHOMP! Golu gobbled up Laddu's whole gola!

narration.text: At Lotus Pond, Pinky was waiting under a big pink umbrella.

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Dadaji's moustache was wiggling, so I listened! Look at those big dark clouds, boys!
Laddu looked up. Plip! One drop. Plip! Two drops. Plip! Three drops!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Three drops? Pah! That's not rain. That's just the sky sneezing!
SPLOOOOSH! Down came the RAIN! Rain is water that falls from the clouds.

narration.text: Under the chai stall's stripy roof, the three friends dripped like wet laundry. Drip, drip, drip!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Sorry, Pinky. We should have listened to Dadaji... and to his moustache!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: And sorry for laughing. Here, have our jalebis. Soggy jalebis are still jalebis!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Hee hee! Thank you! Next time, we all listen together. Deal?
Deal! And they shared every sticky, soggy, yummy jalebi.

This time, Laddu and Chintu listened right away! Quick, quick, quick, to the clothesline!
Chintu folded the shirts. And Laddu? Laddu got all wrapped up in Dadaji's long shawl, like a big round samosa!

narration.speaker: laddu

narration.text: That night, the wind went whoo-whoo, but the clothes were safe inside.

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: You listened, so we were ready for the weather. Well done, boys!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Dadaji, your moustache is wiggling again! What weather is coming now?

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! That's not the weather, Laddu. That's Golu, nibbling my moustache!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
